apps.name: Commodore 64™ eRmulator
apps.versionDescription: C64 emulator for iOS with Metal rendering, cycle-accurate timing, clean-room SID audio, F10 parity settings, and MFi controller support.
apps.localizedDescription: c64ermu is a high-accuracy Commodore 64 emulator for iOS and iPadOS. Features clean-room SID audio, 1541/1571/1581 drive emulation, Simons' BASIC extensions, CRT shaders, and Document Picker support.

news.title: c64ermu 0.10.7 Released
news.caption: Enjoy Commodore 64 games and demos natively on iOS.
